en.sayed-ali-raza: unreasonableness, fear, wavering and undue submission to every thing.
So, he who adopts unreasonableness as his way, for him there is no dawn after the night;
he who is afraid of what befalls him has to run on his heels;
he who wavers in doubt Satans trample him under their feet and he who submits to the destruction of this and the next world succumbs to it.
